people.name: Assyria
people.line: A powerful ancient empire, often in conflict with Israel.

people.name: Nineveh
people.line: The capital of Assyria, known for its wickedness and repentance

translations.web: He will stretch out his hand against the north, destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as the wilderness.
translations.bsb: And He will stretch out His hand against the north and destroy Assyria; He will make Nineveh a desolation, as dry as a desert.
translations.kjv: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria; and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like a wilderness.
translations.asv: And he will stretch out his hand against the north, and destroy Assyria, and will make Nineveh a desolation, and dry like the wilderness.
